name: fresher-ecosystem
description: The complete execution scripts for Fresher Preparation Ecosystem

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node scripts/setup-env.js
scripts.seed: npm run db:init && cd backend && node scripts/import_learning_topics.js && node scripts/create_test_user.js
scripts.dev:apps: npx concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run dev:apps
scripts.docker:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U jobtune jobtune
